items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: a guy came up to me afterwards and he was crying. Because he had such strong memories of the song.

ctx.x: In fact I’ve played this song, I’ve played it for a couple of years, not too very long, but I played it in Hanoi, an American guy, in fact I think it was a couple, but a guy came up to me afterwards and he was crying. Because he had such strong memories of the song. So he was touched and me too. It was so nice.
Yeah. It’s sort of iconic in the States because the Kingston Trio did it after Pete Seeger, and sometimes people play it in church.
